items.title: Enhance account verification signals in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the account verification process by changing the default behavior to only consider disposable email domains as direct evidence. The new command-line option allows for the use of circumstantial signals, such as shared IPs and bulk signup days, but is disabled by default to prevent false positives. This change aims to protect legitimate users while still addressing potential abuse effectively.

items.title: Fix logo display issue on OAuth authorization page in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update resolves a logo display issue on the OAuth authorization page, where user-uploaded logos were incorrectly shown as default placeholders. Key changes include switching to CDN for logo uploads, allowing base64 logos for existing data, and implementing size checks for uploads. Additionally, potential blob URL leaks have been addressed.

items.title: Enhance User Registration Monitoring with Restricted Accounts Flag in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new `is_restricted` flag for user accounts to identify bulk-signup and throwaway accounts. Key changes include the addition of fields for restriction reasons and timestamps, along with a command for scanning and flagging accounts based on specific criteria. This enhancement aims to improve the integrity of user data and marketing reach while ensuring that legitimate users are not affected.

items.title: Fix required parameter issues and enhance feedback in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses three critical bugs identified during live testing. Key changes include ensuring all required parameters are filled based on schema suggestions, improving error messaging to provide users with actionable feedback, and enhancing progress visibility during long-running tasks. These improvements aim to streamline user experience and reduce confusion during interactions with the platform.

items.title: Enhance Task Concurrency for Workers in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the concurrency of task execution in the worker system, allowing each worker to handle multiple tasks simultaneously, up to a defined limit. The changes address a bottleneck that previously restricted task processing to one per replica, significantly enhancing throughput. Additionally, the shutdown process has been refined to ensure no tasks are lost during reboots, improving reliability.

items.title: Enhance command error handling in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the error handling for commands in the browser by ensuring that failures now return a `browser.result` with a `call_id`. This change prevents commands from hanging indefinitely when an error occurs, allowing for better command management and reducing timeout issues. The implementation maintains a consistent structure for both successful and failed commands.

items.title: Enhance Fish TTS Models with s2.1-pro in Skills 🎉
items.summary: This update adds the `s2.1-pro` model to the Fish TTS engine selection in the `skills/fish-audio/SKILL.md` file, ensuring consistency with the values in `fish.json`. The decommissioning of the publisher service has no impact on existing skills, as no publisher skill was present in this repository. Other minor changes include updates to the OpenAPI specs and translations.

items.title: Update Setup Steps and Service Descriptions in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the setup sequence for pairing devices, ensuring users first run the `coding-bridge pair` command to obtain a pair code before claiming it in the browser. Additionally, it clarifies the differences between using Homebrew services and the `service install` command, emphasizing that they should not be used simultaneously. Documentation has been updated to reflect these changes and improve user guidance.

items.title: Enhance Connector Sorting and Skeleton Animation in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces improved sorting for connectors, clustering accounts by type and ensuring the newest entries appear first. Additionally, the skeleton screen animation has been fixed to provide a smoother loading experience, enhancing the overall user interface. These changes aim to eliminate confusion and improve usability on the connections page.

items.title: Fix OAuth link expiration issue in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves the 'Link expired' issue that occurred when OAuth links were shared across multiple server replicas. By storing pending links in MongoDB instead of in-memory, the system ensures durability and consistency, allowing successful link completion regardless of which pod handles the requests. Additionally, new tests have been added to verify the functionality across replicas.

items.title: Allow connection_epoch to be 0 for browser results in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the `BrowserResultPayload` to accept a `connection_epoch` of 0, addressing an issue where the device would return 0 but was previously rejected. The change ensures that the validation process does not fail due to this non-critical field, preventing unnecessary socket closures. Comprehensive tests confirm that the new implementation works as intended without compromising security.

items.title: Set ChatGPT Default Model to GPT-5.6 Sol in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update changes the default ChatGPT model for new users from GPT-5.6 Luna to GPT-5.6 Sol. The change decouples the default model selection from the model list order, ensuring that the default model is now explicitly set while maintaining the existing order for other models. Existing users will not be affected, as their previously selected models will remain unchanged.

items.title: Enhance MCP Tool Timeout for Better Performance in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update increases the timeout for the MCP tools from 60 seconds to 180 seconds, addressing issues with the AI Chat image generation feature that previously failed due to time constraints. The change introduces a configurable timeout setting, ensuring that the tool can handle longer processing times without interruption. Additionally, it maintains the functionality of built-in tools while allowing for improved performance in media API calls.

items.title: Enhance Image Generation with Async Submission in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces asynchronous submission for image generation requests, addressing timeout issues that previously occurred after 60 seconds. Key changes include modifications to the client and tools to support async operations, allowing for immediate task ID retrieval and improved handling of long-running tasks. Documentation has also been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring clarity for users.

items.title: Enhanced API Response Documentation in Wisdom 📚
items.summary: This update enriches the API response models with detailed descriptions for 106 previously undocumented fields across various response types, including AccountResponse and MessageResponse. The changes improve the clarity of the API documentation, ensuring users understand the purpose of each field. All modifications have been validated to maintain semantic integrity, with no behavioral differences introduced.

items.title: Fix audience eligibility gates for email marketing in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update corrects the eligibility criteria for email marketing, significantly increasing the reachable user base from 272 to 148,032. Key changes include removing the requirement for real-name verification and adjusting the criteria for 'canonical relationship' to reflect actual user engagement. Additionally, the implementation has been optimized to handle larger datasets without performance issues.

items.title: Streamlined README for Easier Setup in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: The README has been significantly condensed from 470 lines to 193, focusing on essential installation, configuration, and operational guidance. Key details have been relocated to new documentation files without any loss of information. Additionally, several factual inaccuracies were corrected to enhance clarity and usability for new users.

items.title: Fix relay ack handling and frame limits in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses three key issues in the relay communication process. It modifies the acknowledgment handling to prevent unnecessary disconnections, adjusts the close code to comply with WebSocket standards, and increases the outbound frame limit to match the inbound ceiling. These changes enhance the stability and reliability of the session management.

items.title: Enhance session handling for device compatibility in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update modifies the session handling logic to allow the device to send session.ready payloads without requiring certain fields that it cannot know. The device_id, connection_epoch, and expiry_ms are now optional and will be retrieved from the broker's stored state instead. This change improves compatibility and reduces errors in session delivery.

items.title: Updated Interaction Endpoint and Lazy Initialization in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: The interaction endpoint has been streamlined to `/interactions`, enhancing clarity in the Discord developer portal. Additionally, lazy initialization for Mongo-backed stores has been implemented, resolving issues with module imports that previously required a database. New route contract tests have been added to ensure the integrity of key paths, contributing to a more robust service.

items.title: Refine dropdown menu spacing and cleanup in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update addresses issues with the dropdown menu's separator line and spacing. The margin for the separator has been adjusted to ensure symmetry, and unnecessary code related to a non-functional `::before` pseudo-element has been removed. Additionally, the `multiAccount` property has been deleted as it is no longer in use, streamlining the codebase.

items.title: Launch of Public Bot Acquisition Strategy in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new public bot for Discord aimed at enhancing AceDataCloud's visibility and customer acquisition. The bot allows users to invite it to their servers and utilize slash commands to access AceData's generation capabilities, focusing on organic exposure rather than direct monetization. Key architectural decisions ensure scalability and compliance with Discord's guidelines, setting the stage for future enhancements.

items.title: Launch of Public Discord Bot for AceData's Services in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: We've introduced a public Discord bot that integrates AceData's generation capabilities into slash commands, covering 15 services and 16 commands. This bot allows users to access non-private generation services directly through Discord, enhancing user engagement and acquisition. Key architectural improvements include HTTP interactions without gateway websockets and automated command registration from OpenAPI specs.

items.title: Fix time attestation handling for slim protocol in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update addresses issues with the handling of `time.attestation` frames in the slim protocol. Key changes include storing the `time.attestation` separately and adjusting the validation process to eliminate unnecessary signature checks. The code has been cleaned up, and all tests have passed successfully.

items.title: Update appkit-universal-connector to latest version in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the @reown/appkit-universal-connector from version 1.8.22 to 1.8.23. Key improvements include recovery from Coinbase Wallet signing errors and fixes for the coinbasePreference option. Additionally, the update resolves issues with provider registration and account switching in modals, enhancing overall user experience.

items.title: Aligning Appliance Documentation with OpenAPI Standards in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a significant overhaul of the appliance documentation tab to align it with the public API documentation. Key changes include the transition to an OpenAPI-driven approach, allowing for full component reuse and improved consistency across documentation. The new implementation addresses previous discrepancies in endpoint coverage and enhances user experience with features like online testing and better parameter handling.

items.title: Enhance Default Connection Visibility and Menu Styling in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update improves the visibility of the 'Set as default' option for connector accounts, ensuring it remains visible even when selected as the default. Additionally, it aligns the dropdown menu's border radius with the rest of the page for a consistent look, while also enhancing the hover state for the 'Disconnect' option. These changes enhance user experience and interface consistency.

items.title: Enhance Audience Rule Engine with New Operators in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces several new operators to the audience rule engine, allowing for more flexible audience segmentation. Key additions include `between_days`, `before_days`, and basic comparison operators like `ne`, `gt`, and `lt`. Additionally, new endpoints for rule options and real-time audience estimation have been implemented, enhancing the overall functionality and user experience.

items.title: Archiving Outcome Plans and Adding Calibration Script in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update archives the outcome judge plan and introduces a new calibration script to enhance performance tracking. The calibration script reports task judgment distributions and highlights any discrepancies in success rates, ensuring accurate assessments in production. Key changes include improved failure detection and a more transparent evaluation process.

items.title: Strengthen Maestro Task Security in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the security of the Maestro task management system by addressing vulnerabilities related to actor injection and unauthorized data access. Key changes include restricting the `actor_user_id` to be read only from the query parameters, implementing type guards in data retrieval methods, and adding defensive checks to prevent unauthorized access to user tasks. These improvements ensure a more robust and secure task handling process.

items.title: Fix user identity handling in Platform Service 🔧
items.summary: This update addresses issues with the `/digital-human/tasks` endpoint, ensuring that the correct user identity is used for task retrieval and deletion. Key changes include the introduction of `actor_user_id` to the identity keys and adjustments to the `_identity` function to prevent unauthorized access to task histories. The fix enhances security and maintains compatibility with historical data.

items.title: Revamp Audience Grouping to Backend Driven in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update transitions the audience grouping cards to be driven by backend data, allowing for dynamic rendering of segments without requiring frontend deployments. Key changes include the introduction of six categorized groups and improvements to keyboard navigation and ARIA roles for better accessibility. Additionally, internationalization support has been enhanced across multiple languages.

items.title: Enhance Localization for Scheduled Run Status in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces localized error messages for the 'run_abandoned' status across 18 languages, ensuring users see accurate information rather than a generic error. The message has been changed to 'Run status unknown' to better reflect the situation, avoiding confusion with other error types. All translations have been verified and implemented without relying on English seeds, enhancing the user experience for non-English speakers.

items.title: Revamp Email Audience Segmentation in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a comprehensive overhaul of the email audience segmentation system, addressing issues with dormant user classification and enhancing data accuracy. Key changes include the addition of a new `last_activity_at` field to track user engagement across various sources, along with the introduction of 12 new audience segments. These improvements ensure more precise targeting and better alignment of user communication strategies.

items.title: Upgrade vue-router to 5.2.0 in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps vue-router from version 5.1.0 to 5.2.0, introducing helpful diagnostics and several bug fixes. Key improvements include support for pinia 4 and enhancements to scroll behavior handling. These changes aim to enhance the overall stability and performance of the application.
